## Checklist

- [ ] Every new number has a source with page/table or quote (docs/quality-gates.md)
- [ ] Web sources have archive links where possible
- [ ] No personal data (names of private persons, contacts, IDs) — see docs/testimony-policy.md
- [ ] `python -m pipeline.validate` and `python -m pytest -q` pass
- [ ] If the headline moves: `data/registry/estimates.yaml` updated and the reason explained
